observed_error: AUTH-S02 derived its four auxiliary user UUIDs by adding 1 through 4 to its actor UUID. Those values exactly collided with the primary actor UUIDs reserved for AUTH-S03 through AUTH-S06, so the next authority partition insert raised PostgreSQL unique-integrity failure before the nine-group checkpoint.
detection_method: Attempt 001 failed closed with hashed IntegrityError evidence after schema/catalogue admission; deterministic UUID comparison proved AUTH-S02 actor+1..4 equals AUTH-S03..AUTH-S06 actor identities. Exact owned relay, container and internal network cleanup passed.

correction.action: Move AUTH-S02 auxiliary users into a fixed high disjoint salt domain and add a deterministic cross-scenario UUID-partition regression test before the single permitted occupied rerun.
correction.prevention_control: Behavior rehearsals with derived fixture identities must prove disjointness against every primary and subcase fixture index before runtime admission.
